acceptance: A core PR that adds, removes or changes an entry in the exported docs contract gets one warning annotation per entry and a step-summary list, from a step inside an existing CI job; the step never fails the job
A PR that leaves the contract unchanged produces no warning
Unit tests cover added, removed, changed and unchanged entries
docs/internal/adr/adr-site-docs-ownership.md names the warning where it lists the advisory pre-merge build as related work
context:
Found 2026-10-17 at site-split closeout. Must not become a required context; D17 allows no further ruleset change. Rescoped after core PR 3658 covered path deletions.

Owner decision 2026-10-30: build a core-side contract-change warning. Options considered: a cross-repository advisory site build (needs the benchbox-site-bridge App to gain statuses write and spends shared runner slots on every relevant core PR) and dropping the item (accept detection after merge).
description: The site refuses a core bundle whose exported docs contract (for example CLI options or MCP tool parameters) has entries its docs do not cover: npm run docs:check -- --docs-mode block runs in the site's ci and deploy workflows. Core learns of it only after merge. In #3738 (2026-10-29) the site refused a bundle because get_query_plan.stream was undocumented, and benchbox.dev stayed on the previous bundle for about 5.5 hours until site PR #90 merged. Of 29 site-deploy failure issues from 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-30 it was the only one in this class. On a core PR, export the docs contract for the PR head and for its base, compare them, and report each added, removed or changed entry as a warning, so the author prepares the site docs change before the bundle ships. The check never fails the PR, needs no cross-repository token and adds no runner jobs.
